notes.title: The "Public" update
notes.notes:
We updated Undercover, and added some cool new Features. 
Mainly the update focuses on Playing with other Players all over the World and fixed some Bugs :World:
[h1][u][b]Here are the Changes we made:[/b][/u][/h1]

[b][+] [/b]Added "Find Game" screen where you can find public Lobby's
[b][+][/b] Host screen edited. We edited the Host screen so you can allow "random" Players to join
[b][+] [/b]Chest opening, the Visuals got edited and you now got an little Chest animation.
[b][+] [/b]Kick Players Menu. This window allows you to kick Players if you dont wan't them in your Lobby (Only in the Waiting Lobby, not ingame)
[b][+][/b] Public Chat, you also now can Chat with all Players in your Lobby through the Public Text Chat. For that you can press "T" or use the chat Icon in the Emergency screen
[b][/] [/b]Playerspeed changed from 8.5 to 9 

[h1][b]Coming soon:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] New Roles
[*] New Tasks
[*] Small Map changes
[*] Better UI/UX
[*] Tutorial Level
[*] 
[/list]
If you found any Bugs or got ideas / Feedback for Undercover and let us know so we can make "Undercover" an Fun game for everyone (You can join our Discord server for that) :D

Remeber that the Game is still in "Early Access" so it could be that there are coming some new Bugs with these Changes. 
[b]Until then have fun Playing[/b]
